OrderServiceTests@stage-1 has two cancel tests: NewOrder_SetsStatusCancelled and UnknownOrder_Throws; none checks the cancel notification or a shipped order; the closing comment says the suite is green while a shipped order gets through.

story-example.md: the story is about cancelling an unpaid order; AC 3 hides the cancel button for paid/shipped/cancelled; AC 4 expects 403 for another customer's order; AC 5 expects 409 on a second cancel; the DoD asks for an automated test for every AC.
OrderServiceTests@stage-1 has no test for acceptance criteria 3, 4 or 5 of the cancellation story.

A review for tests should match tests to new behavior; a test that would pass even if the code were wrong checks nothing about that; a test for a new check or fixed bug should fail on the old code first.
A test that seeds a fake with an already-cancelled order and asserts it is cancelled passes even if the service never changes the status.
